Omega Auto & Smash Repair, located in Coopers Plains, QLD, is a trusted automotive service provider recognised for accurately diagnosing and resolving complex vehicle issues. Our experienced technicians utilise advanced testing and diagnostic techniques to identify faults, deliver precise repairs, and implement preventive measures to enhance long-term vehicle performance. We pride ourselves on offering exceptional service at competitive rates, giving customers confidence in the safety and reliability of their vehicles.

Position: Motor Mechanic

Location: Coopers Plains, QLD

Key Responsibilities
•	Perform thorough inspections to identify faults in engines and major vehicle systems, enabling accurate and timely repairs.
•	Dismantle, examine, and repair engines, transmissions, steering systems, and other key mechanical components, assessing wear and damage.
•	Install new or refurbished parts and reassemble mechanical systems using appropriate service manuals and specifications.
•	Conduct routine servicing to optimise vehicle efficiency and ensure compliance with environmental and industry standards.
•	Test repaired engines and systems using advanced diagnostic tools to verify proper functionality.
•	Assess vehicles for roadworthiness and identify repairs required to meet safety and compliance regulations.
•	Maintain and monitor stock levels of parts, tools, and consumables required for workshop operations.
•	Collaborate with team members to troubleshoot and resolve complex mechanical issues.
•	Accurately record all repair and maintenance activities for customer reference and warranty support.
•	Provide customers with clear guidance on maintenance requirements, repair options, and overall vehicle condition.

Work Hours: Full-time, 38 hours per week.

Requirements
•	Minimum 3 years of experience as a Motor Mechanic.
•	AQF Certificate III or IV in Automotive Mechanical Technology or a related discipline.

Salary: $75,000–$85,000 per annum plus superannuation.

Personal Attributes
•	Strong attention to detail with a commitment to delivering high-quality workmanship.
•	Excellent diagnostic, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work well under pressure.
•	Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative approach.
•	Proactive attitude towards keeping up to date with industry developments and emerging technologies.

We are seeking motivated professionals who take pride in their work, value precision, and are committed to maintaining our high standards of service. Join Omega Auto & Smash Repair and become part of a team that values expertise, dedication, and customer satisfaction. Apply now to take the next step in your automotive career.

Job Description:
Kandui Group is a growing financial modelling / advisory firm based in Sydney, Australia. We work with founder-led organisations that are focused on improving margins, scalability and maintaining year-on-year consistency. We are committed to long-term partnerships and only providing solutions with measurable ROI’s.


As a Business Intelligence Developer, you will become the bridge between the technical world of data and the strategic needs of our clients. This is not your average developer or analyst role as you'll need to be a data expert, have an eye for beautiful dashboards and ultimately, be a champion of user-friendly insights.


Responsibilities:
Build clear and compelling dashboards for a diverse range of clientele to transform raw data into actionable insights.
Collate, transform and analyse data from varying sources.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand their needs and translate complex business problems into technical solutions.
Write clean, efficient, and maintainable SQL code as fluency in the language of data is a must.
Work with cloud technologies such as AWS or Azure to design and implement data solutions.
Apply architecture best practices to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and reliable.
Understand and implement integrations between cloud services and on-premise or third-party applications.
Stay ahead of the curve and explore new technologies and methodologies to keep our data game strong.


The right person will have:
Proficiency in SQL, data warehousing concepts, and ETL processes.
Demonstrable BI Dev / BA experience - understanding of key business concepts and the ability to translate them into technical solutions.
Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or others.
Experience with automating ETL processes, reports, or data workflows to optimize and scale data operations.
Basic understanding of architecture best practices, including scalability, security, and reliability.
Exceptional communication skills which include being about to clearly explain complex data concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Exceptional problem-solving skills with the ability to identify data challenges and develop effective solutions.
A passion for data and a desire to make an impact – you're excited to leverage data to drive business success.
Power BI experience essential.
Based in Sydney.


Behavioural:
Bring a positive, enthusiastic, "can-do" attitude to the office each day and help build-on the strong culture at Kandui Group.
Ability to meet deadlines and balance competing pressures.
Have an interest in understanding and adding value to the business.
Rigorous attention to detail.
Ability to work in [and enjoy] a team environment.
Strong appetite to come into the office everyday.

•	Conduct regular vehicle maintenance and carry out complex repairs, including engine, transmission, brakes, and suspension systems, ensuring vehicle safety and reliability.

•	Manage and maintain service logbooks for customers' vehicles, ensuring the vehicle's warranty is maintained, and customers are well-informed about their vehicle's service history.

•	Assist in the maintenance, replacement, and repair of tyres and batteries, crucial aspects of vehicle performance and safety.

Key Skills and Attributes:

•	Cert III or higher certification in the relevant field.

•	At least 1 year of post-qualification experience as a Motor Mechanic.

•	Excellent technical knowledge of vehicle systems.

•	A professional attitude in the workshop at all times.

•	Ability to maneuver in tight spaces and physically able to lift and move heavy parts.

•	Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

•	An eye for detail to diagnose and fix complex issues.

Our client Thinksupreme Pty Ltd (TSPL), ABN: 99 648 206 393 (Business name: Supreme Aluminium Windows) located at: Unit 3 78 Heathcote Rd Moorebank NSW 2170. Proudly Australian owned and operated for over 60 years, they have been Sydney's most trusted supplier of aluminium windows & doors. They manufacture a large range of residential and commercial windows and doors using top of the line materials and cutting-edge production technologies. They specialise in New Builds, Developments, Renovations, Office, Commercial or Industrial Windows & Doors.

Due to their business growth and expansion plans, USVD is now looking to recruit Machinist(s) in their Operations team on a permanent full-time basis.

Role: Machinist
No. of positions: Multiple, minimum 02
Reports to: Operations Supervisor
Location: Unit 3 78 Heathcote Rd MOOREBANK NSW 2170
Annual offered salary: AUD $82,000 - $88,000 base + Super (for a 38-hour work week)

Purpose of the role: We are seeking an experienced Machinist or may be two to join our operations team on a full-time basis. Set up and operate lathes, CNC, Milling, Grinding, Drilling & Turning machines to produce metal components to the specified tolerances, in accordance with technical drawings and safety requirements as per Australian standards.

As a Machinist, your main duties and responsibilities include:
•	Interpret engineering and technical drawings, sketches and specifications (including AS 1100/AS 1102 standards) to determine job requirements, tolerances and machining sequences.
•	Set up and operate lathes to perform turning operations, producing components to specified tolerances using a full range of lathe accessories.

Thornton Engineering is seeking a skilled Construction Project Manager in our facility in Corio, Victoria to oversee and coordinate activities within our Pressure Vessel Division. The role is responsible for planning, resource allocation, progress tracking, and ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to strict quality and safety standards.

You will lead and mentor closely with internal stakeholders, and support the implementation of best-practice systems, technical processes, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
- Plan, allocate, and coordinate labor and resources for vessel projects.
- Monitor project progress against schedule, quality targets, and budget, escalating issues where required.
- Provide technical advice and support with MDR (Manufacturer Data Record) requirements.
- Provide leadership to the specialized construction and vessel installation teams.
- Drive adherence to OHS, QA, and internal compliance systems.
- Mentor team members, encourage skills development, and support implementation of improved workflows.
- Ensure accurate job costing, reporting, and keeping across all projects.
- Uphold integrity, transparency, and professionalism in all dealings with internal and external stakeholders.

Skills & Experience Required
To be considered for this role, candidates should demonstrate:
- At least 1 year of experience

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in engineering (or equivalent).
- First Aid Level 2 certification.
- Evidence of ongoing professional development.

Technical & Professional Skills
- Strong ability to build and maintain effective working relationships across teams.
- Experience analyzing and resolving complex technical and operational issues.
- Effective communication and organizational skills.
- Ability to lead and support teams under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
- Demonstrated initiative, leadership capability, and sound judgement.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, Project).


Salary range is $130,000 - $160,000pa commensurate with experience.

Fulltime Position available

Applications open on 1st July 2026 and closes on 1st August 2026

result.description:
Title: Enrolled Nurse
Occupation: ANZSCO 411411 – Enrolled Nurse
Salary: $79,500.00 – $85,000.00 per annum plus superannuation
Hours: Full-time
Trading Name: Havilah Hostel Inc
Employer: Havilah Hostel Inc
Location: 11 Harkness Street, Maryborough VIC 3465

About Us
Havilah Inc is a respected aged-care provider based in Maryborough, Central Victoria. We operate across three well-established sites, with exciting developments underway to meet growing community needs:

Harkness Street: 110 residential aged-care places and 9 independent living units
Palmerston Street: 32 residential aged-care places and 44 independent living units
The Terrace: 24 residential aged-care places
Boronia House: A new 24-bed care facility currently under construction

Why Choose Havilah?
Be part of a high-performing and compassionate care team
Access generous salary packaging benefits
Build your career in a supportive aged-care environment
Join a growing organisation with new care facilities in development

About the Role
As an Enrolled Nurse, you will support the health, comfort and wellbeing of aged-care residents by providing person-centred nursing care in accordance with professional standards, resident care plans and the direction of Registered Nurses. The role involves working collaboratively with Registered Nurses, personal care workers and other team members to deliver safe, respectful and high-quality care to residents.

What We’re Looking For
A genuine passion for aged care and a commitment to best-practice care
Strong communication, teamwork and time-management skills
The ability to work collaboratively with Registered Nurses and care staff
Sound computer literacy and accurate documentation skills
A professional, compassionate and resident-focused approach

Key Selection Criteria

1. Qualifications and Compliance
Current AHPRA registration as an Enrolled Nurse
Understanding of the Aged Care Quality Standards
Valid National Police Check dated within two months, or willingness to obtain one
Current right to work in Australia, or eligibility for employer sponsorship where applicable

2. Skills and Experience
Minimum 1 year of experience in a relevant nursing or aged-care role
Ability to manage workloads, prioritise tasks and respond appropriately to residents’ changing care needs
Strong communication, clinical documentation and reporting skills
Ability to support safe care delivery in collaboration with Registered Nurses and care team members
Proficiency in de-escalation techniques and respectful resident engagement

3. Technical Proficiency
Familiarity with aged-care software systems
Sound understanding of occupational health and safety, infection control and compliance requirements
Ability to maintain accurate records in line with workplace policies and clinical standards

4. Personal Attributes
Empathy, professionalism and a strong commitment to resident dignity
Collaborative and team-focused approach
Reliability, accountability and a willingness to contribute to continuous improvement
Commitment to ongoing professional development

Visa Sponsorship
Nomination for a temporary work visa and/or permanent residency may be considered for eligible candidates.

Duties
Assess residents’ nursing care needs and assist in developing, implementing and reviewing individual care plans in line with accepted nursing practice, professional standards and Havilah’s care procedures.
Deliver nursing interventions, treatments and therapies, including medication administration, wound care, clinical observations and ongoing monitoring of residents’ responses to care and treatment plans.
Work under the direction of Registered Nurses and collaborate with other care team members to coordinate, document and evaluate the care provided to residents.
Support residents with health education, wellness activities and preventative care strategies that promote independence, safety, dignity and quality of life.
Assist residents with daily living and personal care needs, including hygiene, grooming, mobility, nutrition, hydration, continence care and comfort.
Provide person-centred support to residents living with dementia, complex care needs or changing health conditions, while observing and reporting any concerns to Registered Nurses.
Communicate respectfully with residents, families and representatives, providing reassurance, practical information and emotional support in relation to residents’ care and wellbeing.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and maintain ongoing professional development in accordance with professional registration and workplace requirements.

Application Process

Please note that only successful candidates will receive a reply. Applicants who contact the employer directly or submit applications outside of this online portal will not be considered.

If you are a dedicated and compassionate Enrolled Nurse ready to make a meaningful impact, we would love to hear from you. Join Havilah and help us deliver high-quality, person-centred care to our residents.
